description: Ministry of Highways and Investment Promotion - Order to declare that the Kadawatha Bypass to be a National Highway
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the declaration of a road as a National Highway under the National Thoroughfares Act, No. 40 of 2008. It constitutes a regulatory action where the Minister exercises powers vested by legislation to make a formal declaration. The content includes detailed specifications about the road, its components, and legal requirements under the Act, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural change.
